definition_zh: 两足动物；两足行走的动物；两足的（形容词用法）
definition_en: an animal that walks on two feet; two-footed
core_image: 恐龙与人类同框：都是踩着两只脚走路
scene: 展厅里，恐龙骨架和人骨架并排站立。Humans are bipeds, unlike their four-footed cousins.
sceneCN: 这里 biped 是「两足动物」（第 1 个义项：以两脚行走的动物）；句意是与其四足的远亲不同，人类是两足动物。

derivatives.zh: biped 加 -al，义为「两足的；用两足行走的」
bipedal 加 -ism，义为「两足行走习性」
同族反义词，义为「四足动物」
同根词，义为「踏板」，来自 pes「足」

senses.title: An animal walking on two feet
senses.definition: a creature that habitually moves about on two legs
senses.definitionCN: 惯于用两条腿移动的动物
senses.example: Humans are bipeds, unlike their four-footed cousins.
senses.exampleCN: 与其四足的远亲不同，人类是两足动物。
senses.why: Latin bi- means two and pes means foot: two-footed.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 bi- 意为「二」，pes 意为「足」，合即「双足」。

senses.title: A bird as a two-footed creature
senses.definition: any bird, whose only limbs for walking are its two feet
senses.definitionCN: 泛指以两足为行走器官的鸟类
senses.example: Every sparrow is a feathered biped.
senses.exampleCN: 每只麻雀都是有羽毛的两足动物。
senses.why: Zoology counts feet: birds have exactly two.
senses.whyCN: 动物学按足计数：鸟类恰好两只。

senses.title: Dinosaurs that ran on hind legs
senses.titleCN: （兽脚类恐龙）两足行走的恐龙
senses.definition: a dinosaur of groups that moved on their hind limbs
senses.definitionCN: 以后肢行走的恐龙类群
senses.exampleCN: 暴龙是有力的两足动物。
senses.why: Paleontology adopted the foot-count for dinosaurs.
senses.whyCN: 古生物学以足数命名恐龙姿态。

senses.title: Two-footed as adjective
senses.example: The biped robot took its first steps.
senses.exampleCN: 这台两足机器人迈出了第一步。
senses.why: The noun doubles as an adjective in engineering.
senses.whyCN: 在工程语境中该名词兼作形容词。

senses.title: A human being (formal or playful)
senses.definition: a human, viewed humorously or formally as a two-footed animal
senses.definitionCN: 以两足动物之名正式或戏谑地指人
senses.example: The picnic fed twenty hungry bipeds.
senses.exampleCN: 野餐喂饱了二十个饥肠辘辘的两足动物。
senses.why: Man is the everyday biped, so the word can point at us.
senses.whyCN: 人是最寻常的两足动物，故该词可指向我们。

senses.title: Robots on two legs
senses.definition: a walking robot with two leg mechanisms
senses.definitionCN: 装有两足行走机构的机器人
senses.exampleCN: 工程师调试双足机器人的平衡。
senses.whyCN: 机器人学借用动物学的足数分类。

senses.title: Habitual versus occasional bipedalism
senses.definition: an animal defined by regular two-footed movement, as opposed to occasional stance
senses.definitionCN: 以经常性两足移动定义的动物，区别于偶尔站立
senses.example: Chimps stand up often but are not true bipeds.
senses.exampleCN: 黑猩猩常站起来，但并非真正的两足动物。
senses.why: Habit, not moment, fixes the class.
senses.whyCN: 决定类别的在于习性而非瞬间。

senses.title: In evolutionary argument
senses.definition: bipedalism as a marker in debates on human origins
senses.definitionCN: 两足行走作为人类起源争论中的标志特征
senses.example: Fossil feet settled when our line became bipeds.
senses.exampleCN: 足部化石确定了我们的谱系何时成为两足动物。
senses.why: Feet in fossils testify to the two-footed turn.
senses.whyCN: 化石中的足部为「双足转向」作证。

intro.en: Biped is Latin bi-, two, plus pes, foot.
intro.cn: biped 由拉丁语 bi-「二」加 pes「足」构成。

items.en: dwo- meant two; ped- meant foot; reconstructed forms.
items.cn: dwo- 意为「二」；ped- 意为「足」（重构形式）。
拉丁语 bipes 意为「双足的」。

items.en: the compound passed through learned use into French.
items.cn: 该复合词经学术用语传入法语。

items.en: English adopted biped in the 17th century as a zoological term.
items.cn: 英语于 17 世纪借入 biped，作为动物学术语。

items.en: now covers humans, birds, dinosaurs, and walking robots.
items.cn: 如今涵盖人类、鸟类、恐龙与步行机器人。

note.en: The look-alike group shares bi- or ped- roots; the near-meaning group gathers foot-words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bi- 或 ped- 词根；近义组汇集「足」类词。

entries.definitionCN: 两足行走的——形容词形式
人族——以两足行走为特征
两足行走习性——派生名词

normalIntro.cn: biped 是 bi-（二）加 pes（足）。

abstract.en: See footprints in pairs down a beach.
abstract.cn: 看沙滩上成双成对的脚印。

abstract.en: Feel the wobble of a toddler's first two-legged walk.
abstract.cn: 感受幼儿初学双腿行走时的摇晃。

abstract.en: Picture a robot balancing on metal feet.
abstract.cn: 想象机器人靠金属双足保持平衡。

examples.en: Humans are bipeds, unlike their four-footed cousins.
examples.cn: 与其四足的远亲不同，人类是两足动物。
暴龙是有力的两足动物。

examples.en: The biped robot took its first steps.
examples.cn: 这台两足机器人迈出了第一步。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「摆·佩德」——双脚摆得笔直，佩德（ped＝足）二字写在脚底。

root: 拉丁语 bi-「二」（上溯原始印欧语 dwo-，重构形式）加 pes「足」（词干 ped-，上溯原始印欧语 ped-「足」，重构形式）；拉丁语 bipes「双足的」，17 世纪进入英语作动物学术语，现代兼指恐龙、鸟类与双足机器人。

sensesIntro.en: A foot-count of two separates birds, beasts, humans, and robots from the four-footed world.
sensesIntro.cn: 「足数为二」把鸟类、兽类、人类与机器人从四足世界中分出来。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a body balanced on two points
core.cn: 核心意象：身体平衡于两个支点之上

branches.en: Birds and dinosaurs counted by feet

branches.cn: 作为寻常两足动物的人

intro.en: Biped is a Latin number-plus-foot compound.
intro.cn: biped 是拉丁语「数词加足」的复合词。

latinIntro.en: The ped- family of foot-words in Latin and English.
